overview_description.description: Carrot Fertility is a fertility treatment center that provides financial and medical services for employees. Their program includes egg freezing, in vitro fertilization, donor, gestational carrier services, adoption, and pregnancy. They help people through fertility preservation, male-factor infertility, postpartum, gestational surrogacy, and menopause.

about_short_description.short_description: Carrot Fertility is a fertility healthcare company for employers and health plans.

product.name: Carrot Fertility Platform
product.description: An employer- and health-plan-sponsored fertility and family-building benefits platform providing personalized care navigation, clinical guidance, provider access, education, and financial support.

product.name: Assisted Reproduction Support
product.description: Clinical and benefits support for IVF, IUI, ovulation tracking, nutrition counseling, and other fertility treatments, including treatment navigation, medication coordination, and outcome-focused guidance.

product.name: Fertility Preservation
product.description: Guidance and benefits support for egg, sperm, and embryo freezing, including preparation, fertility assessments, provider selection, storage coordination, and virtual expert access.

product.name: Carrot Rx
product.description: A fertility and hormonal-health medication service that coordinates prescriptions, medication education, discounted access, and virtual pharmacist support.

product.name: Carrot Card
product.description: A payment card and financial administration service that helps eligible members pay for covered fertility and family-building care without relying solely on reimbursement.

product.name: Pregnancy and Postpartum Support
product.description: Expert and educational support from pregnancy through postpartum, including guidance from midwives, doulas, nutritionists, OB/GYNs, lactation consultants, and emotional-support specialists.
